observations: Photo 0: Blue plastic cylindrical drum with a screw/bolt-down lid and metal latches; small round cap/plug on top.
Photo 0: Drum has visible scuffs/scratches and some stains; no readable label/brand on the drum face.

identity.kind: plastic chemical drum / storage drum (blue, lidded)

claims.evidence: No quality standard, testing, or condition proof shown in the photos; seller text is generic.

risks.risk: What the drum was previously used for (chemical compatibility/contamination) is unknown from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of any label/markings on the drum and the previous contents (or a receipt/usage history).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used/unknown-content drum (worst case: may be contaminated; treat as not suitable for food/medical use).

risks.risk: Leakage risk due to lid seal condition, cracks, or warped rim is not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the lid seal area and a fill-and-leak test (or at least a water-tightness demonstration).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially not leak-proof (worst case: needs reconditioning or may leak).

risks.risk: Capacity/size is unknown; pricing depends heavily on volume (e.g., 50L/100L/200L).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a measuring tape or the exact stated capacity/size on the drum label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely value for a generic used plastic drum without confirmed capacity.

risks.risk: Condition (dents, hairline cracks, lid hardware wear) could reduce usability.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lid rim, latch points, and any cracks/repairs (plus underside if possible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with cosmetic wear and possible functional wear.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of any label/markings on the drum (brand, capacity, previous contents).
A photo of the lid seal/rim and latch hardware from close range.
A short video showing the drum being filled and checked for leaks (or a water-tightness test).
Confirm the exact capacity (liters) and whether it’s food-grade/chemical-grade.
response.reason: The photos show a used blue plastic lidded drum, but key pricing drivers are missing: exact capacity, prior contents/contamination, and leak-tight condition. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
